points.requirement: Distinguish an attached innate agonist from incidental immune effects of a conventional cytotoxic ADC or T-cell bridging.

evidence.explanation: Defines deliberately attached innate agonists, separately from secondary cytotoxic inflammation and T-cell bridging.

points.requirement: Retain construct-specific STING or TLR sensing, antigen and Fc-dependent uptake routes and relevant cancer or immune-cell context.

evidence.explanation: Retains distinct antigen/Fc uptake and TLR or STING signaling in tested cancer or immune compartments.

points.requirement: Separate inflammatory activation from antigen presentation, functional T-cell recruitment and durable tumor killing.

evidence.explanation: Separates uptake, innate cytokine activation, antigen presentation, functional responding cells and target-cell death.

points.requirement: Retain systemic cytokine, immunogenicity and adaptive-resistance questions and distinguish trial discontinuation reasons from proof of biological failure.

evidence.explanation: Retains systemic inflammation, anti-drug antibodies, counter-regulation and exact study termination reasons.

points.requirement: Keep cell or mouse immune memory, early human pharmacodynamic or safety observations and clinical efficacy separate.

evidence.explanation: Keeps mouse-model immune findings, NJH395 human pharmacodynamics/harms and comparative benefit separate; the cohort is non-breast.

points.requirement: Retain potency, efflux handling, permeability, release and activity against defined mutants as different tested properties.

points.requirement: Separate engineered resistance models and selected patient mutation evidence from demonstrated post-ADC clinical benefit.

points.requirement: Retain target delivery, TOP1 availability and cell-response or repair dependencies; no one redesign guarantees escape.

points.requirement: Compare actual released species, matched exposure, transporter perturbations, local versus distant neighbor models and defined mutant assays with controls.

evidence.explanation: Requires actual released species, matched exposure, transporter perturbations, local/distant controls and defined mutant assays.

evidence.explanation: Retains normal-cell transcription, actual released chemistry, linker stability and antigen/OATP-mediated uptake as safety questions.

points.requirement: Keep corrected or retracted work, preclinical results, sponsor reports and trial registration separate from verified human benefit; do not infer conjugate activity from nanoparticle siRNA studies.

evidence.explanation: Distinguishes corrected/retracted studies, siRNA nanoparticles, conjugates, sponsor reports, registries and patient outcomes.

priorReview.auditor: GPT-6.1 Sol coordinator; semantic and source assessment at stated primary/inference scope, not blind, expert, learner or language acceptance
priorReview.rationale: Complete light and dark files viewed at full extent; SVGs rendered in Chrome, PNG themes inspected independently. Only the illustrated teaching receives points. One minor label-spacing issue is queued. No live Guide, accessibility or scientific expert certification.

points.requirement: Fictional Drug Z: four 10-unit doses; windows 0-4 wk and 0-8 wk with a declared final nominal interval; cumulative 40 both; intensity 40/4=10 and 40/8=5 units/week; with A as reference B is 50% intensity, not 50% benefit.

evidence.explanation: The declared final-interval convention makes equal 40-unit totals yield 10 versus 5 units per week, without halving benefit.
evidence.supportingExcerpt: In the fictional four-dose example, both schedules use the same Drug Z and formulation. The first window is week 0 up to week 4, with administrations at weeks 0, 1, 2 and 3; the second is week 0 up to week 8, with administrations at weeks 0, 2, 4 and 6. Each declared window includes one nominal final interval and no administration at its right endpoint. Both totals are 40 arbitrary units, but the intensities are 10 and 5 units per week. A different final-cycle convention needs its own definition. Cumulative dose retains amount units; intensity adds a time denominator; relative intensity is the dimensionless ratio to a stated reference.

priorAssetReviews.reconciliation: The new unit-17 arithmetic point retains the entire fixed-window premise; unit 20 adds the no-benefit-or-safety inference. No new asset path is counted for this repeat review.
